field_research.observation_row.description: A structured candidate produced deterministically from one observation-log row.

field_research.observation.description: A reviewed statement about what was observed in the bounded field case.

field_research.interpretation.description: A reviewed interpretation of one or more preserved observations.

field_research.hypothesis.description: A possible explanation kept distinct from observation and evaluation.

field_research.experimental_action.description: A recorded intervention or configuration change.

field_research.outcome.description: A reviewed result or comparison following an experimental action.

field_research.evaluation.description: A bounded assessment that may explicitly limit causal interpretation.

field_research.decision.description: A project decision about a planned or future research action.
